name: What is the typical timeline for a major home renovation project?
description: Major home renovations can take 3-6 months or more, depending on scope and complexity. Smaller projects might be 4-8 weeks.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a major home renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a major home renovation varies significantly depending on the project's scope, complexity, and required permits. Smaller renovations, like a bathroom remodel, might take 4-8 weeks, while larger projects such as a whole-house remodel or an addition can extend from 3-6 months or even longer. Factors like material availability, unforeseen structural issues, and local inspection schedules also influence the overall duration. A detailed project schedule will be provided after the initial design and planning phase.
